_comment: 规格 352 P1：改写前的 ToolSpec.doc 原文（证据迁移的零丢失判据）

docs.solidworks_topology_create_study: Create a topology optimization study (analysis type 13) on the ACTIVE part. Topology optimization works on ONE single-body part at a time (official limit). Returns which entry point was used (CreateNewStudy3, or a fallback).
docs.solidworks_topology_evidence: Read back the topology studies on the active document: names, analysis types, and which constraints/controls exist. Read-only.
docs.solidworks_topology_run: Mesh and solve the topology study and report whether results exist. A zero RunAnalysis return code does NOT mean success - judge by study results.
docs.solidworks_mold_parting_line: Insert a mold parting line. Select the draft-direction reference first (edge/plane/axis); without it the call inserts nothing.
docs.solidworks_mold_shut_off_surface: Auto-create shut-off surfaces over holes for mold separation. Zero parameters.
docs.solidworks_mold_draft_analysis: Run mold draft analysis. Returns the official return code as-is: that code has NO published enum, so this tool does NOT judge success from it.
docs.solidworks_mold_evidence: ★ **当前这条在真机上**读不到东西**、★ 如实说明** —— 处置 `JUDGE-C_D_E.md` 的 🔴 **#14**（★ `E-1 #9`）：★ 原 doc 逐字写「Read back the mold state of the active part: parting-line/surface and cavity/core surface counts, parting type, core-cavity split. **Read-only.**」⇒ ★★ 而**能力层自己的 docstring 逐字**写着「⚠ **本函数当前仍从旧位置读** ⇒ ★ **它在真机上只会返回全 `None`**」（★ `scripts/sw_mold.py::mold_evidence`）⇒ ★★★ **两处说法相反** ✓ ★★ **真因（★ 轮 172 真机 + 反射复核）**：★ 那些计数**不在 `IFeatureManager` / `IModelDoc2` 上**（★ 实测全 `AttributeError: <unknown>.X`），★ 而在 **`I*FeatureData`** 上（★ `GetPartingLinesCount` ⇒ `IPartingLineFeatureData` · `PartingType` ⇒ `IPartingSurfaceFeatureData` · `CoreCavitySplit` ⇒ `IPartingLineFeatureData` —— ★ 事实 36 那一族：**成员在别的接口上**）✓ ★★★ **⇒ 要真读到，必须先拿到对应的 `I*FeatureData`**（★ 从**已存在的**分型线/分型面特征上取）⇒ ★ **前提是零件上**已经有那些特征**；★ 空零件上**本来就取不到**（★ **两者表象相同、别混**）✓ ★★★★ **∴ 现在**：★ `read_only=True` 仍然成立（★ 它确实不改模型）· ★★ 但**读到的计数会全是 `None`** ⇒ ★ 请按返回值里的 **`readable`** 字段判（★ `false` = 本机读不到、★ **不是**「没有分型」）✓
docs.solidworks_simulation_set_material: Assign a material to the active part and RETURN THE READ-BACK MaterialIdName. An empty string means it did NOT take effect (the API itself returns void).
docs.solidworks_weldment_evidence: Read back the weldment state: structural members, cut-list folders, and their quantity/length/angle/source properties. Read-only when create_missing_cut_list is False.
docs.solidworks_weldment_ensure_cut_list: Create the cut list if it is missing, and return the cut-list folders.
docs.solidworks_weldment_update_cut_list: Refresh the cut list and return the updated folders.
docs.solidworks_weldment_create_sub_weld_fold: Create a sub-weldment folder in the active weldment part.
docs.solidworks_sheet_metal_evidence: Read back the sheet-metal state of the active part: thickness, bend radius, bend allowance settings, flat-pattern state. Read-only. VERIFIED ON A REAL MACHINE: run 2026-10-01 on SW 2026 SP4.1 and it read back correctly (thickness_m=0.002, has_base_flange=True, all_solid_bodies_are_sheet_metal=True).
docs.solidworks_surface_evidence: Read back the surface bodies on the active document: counts and types. Read-only.
docs.solidworks_sheet_metal_create_base_flang: Create a native base flange (swFmBaseFlange) from an open or closed sketch. Returns the real IFeature; failures raise instead of returning empty. ⚠⚠ **正确性边界（2026-10-04 更正，★ 处置 JUDGE-C_D_E 🔴 #2 · E-1 #4）**：★ **只有闭轮廓**真机跑通（2026-10-01，SW 2026 SP4.1，特征树出现「钣金6 / 基体-法兰1 / 平展型式6」）；★★ **开放折线（轮廓法兰）真机失败** —— `CreateFeature(IBaseFlangeFeatureData) 创建失败`（2026-10-01 补测）。★★★ **旧描述（已作废）**：本节此前写「An open polyline path produces a profile flange … VERIFIED ON A REAL MACHINE … and it WORKED」，那是把**闭轮廓**的成功**外推**到了开放折线上 —— 而状态表明写 **`True` 仅对闭轮廓成立**。⇒ ★ **以 `scripts/sw_sheet_metal.py::SHEET_METAL_RUNTIME_STATUS` 为准**（★ 它是第一现场）。
docs.solidworks_sheet_metal_create_one_bend: Create a single sheet-metal bend on the selected sketch. ⚠ **仍不可用，但原因已具体化**（2026-10-04 更正，★ 处置 JUDGE-C_D_E 🔴 #2 · E-1 #1）。★★ **旧描述（已作废）**：`CreateDefinition(33) returned None` · 「The correct call shape has not been determined yet」——★ 那是**旧结论**：状态表把它标为「原记法」。★★★ **现在的事实**：正确入口**已查明并已改用** —— `swFmSketchBend(35)`（接口 `ISketchedBendFeatureData`），真机已验证 `CreateDefinition(35)` 返回**非 None**；⚠ 仍缺「选中折弯线 / 固定面」这一步 ⇒ **仍标不可用**，但**卡点不是「形状未查明」**。⇒ ★ **以 `scripts/sw_sheet_metal.py::SHEET_METAL_RUNTIME_STATUS` 为准**（★ 第一现场）。★ 本工具保留，是为了让失败**可诊断**，不是因为能用。
docs.solidworks_sheet_metal_create_edge_flang: ★★ **本机（SW 2026 SP4.1 + pywin32）仍不可用**：`SetFixedFace` / `AccessSelections` 属**进程内指针族**，pywin32 迟到绑定下调不动（事实 47，20+ 形态已穷尽）。Create a native edge flange on a SELECTED edge. The edge is selected for you from `selection` BEFORE the call (the implementation requires a pre-existing selection). ⚠ **仍不可用，但报错已前移**（2026-10-04 更正，★ 处置 JUDGE-C_D_E 🔴 #2 · E-1 #2）。★★ **旧描述（已作废）**：`setting \`ReverseDirection\` gave \`Property ... can not be set\`` ——★ 那条**属性层**的错**已修掉**：`ReverseDirection` **不属于** `IEdgeFlangeFeatureData`（★ 跨接口泄漏），★★ **代码里已删除**该设置（★ 原处只剩一条说明性注释）。★★★ **现在的事实**：★ 报错已从「属性设不上」**前移到** `CreateFeature(37) 创建失败` ⇒ **卡点在创建、不在属性**。⇒ ★ **以 `scripts/sw_sheet_metal.py::SHEET_METAL_RUNTIME_STATUS` 为准**（★ 第一现场）；★ 按旧描述排查会**停在一条已经不存在的死路上**。
docs.solidworks_sheet_metal_create_gusset: ★★ **本机（SW 2026 SP4.1 + pywin32）仍不可用**：`ISMGussetFeatureData` 的 `AccessSelections` 属**进程内指针族**（事实 47）；★ 属性层已修好，但**特征建不出来**。Create a native sheet-metal gusset on a SELECTED supporting face. The face is selected for you from `selection` BEFORE the call. ⚠ **仍不可用，但属性层已修好**（2026-10-04 更正，★ 处置 JUDGE-C_D_E 🔴 #2 · E-1 #3）。★★ **旧描述（已作废）**：`setting \`Thickness\` gave \`Property ... can not be set\`` ——★ **真因不是「属性只读」，是接口不对**：`Thickness` 是**焊件族**的名字，★ 本工具要走的是**钣金族**的 `ISMGussetFeatureData` ⇒ ★ 已改设 `GussetThickness`（★ 源码里注明「原 Thickness（焊件名）」）。★★★ **现在的事实**：★ 改用 `GussetThickness` / `ProfileHeightDim` / `ProfileLengthDim` / `ProfileAngleDim` 后**真机属性层读回全部成功**（0.002 / 0.01 / 0.01 / 45.0）；★ 报错已变为 `CreateFeature(118) 创建失败` ⇒ **卡点在创建、不在属性**。⇒ ★ **以 `scripts/sw_sheet_metal.py::SHEET_METAL_RUNTIME_STATUS` 为准**（★ 第一现场）；★ 按旧描述排查会**以为属性设不上而去找别的属性名**。
docs.solidworks_sheet_metal_create_draft: ★★ **2026-10-09（规格 239）创建路径已按官方页改写**：**旧描述（已作废）** —— `CreateDefinition(3)`（`swFmDraft`）**不是合法类型** ⇒ 回 `None`；★ 那是**真机事实**，但**根因**是「`swFmDraft` 不在任何官方 `CreateDefinition` 宿主页的 `Type` 清单里」（规格 238 已证）⇒ **这条路径官方根本不支持**，不是参数没调对。★★ **现在的路径**：官方入口 **`IFeatureManager::InsertMultiFaceDraft`**（★ 其前代 `IModelDoc2::InsertMfDraft` / `InsertMfDraft2` 两页都写着 `Obsolete. Superseded by IFeatureManager::InsertMultifaceDraft`）。Create a native draft on a SELECTED face. The face is selected for you from `selection` BEFORE the call; per the official `## Remarks` the selections must be made with `IModelDocExtension::SelectByID2` (direction mark 1, faces to draft mark 2, draft edges mark 4). NOTE: the implementation's own `face_ref` parameter is accepted but NEVER USED (verified by reading the body); this tool therefore omits it and selects from `selection` instead, matching the docstring ('on the already-selected face'). *** NOT VERIFIED ON THE TEST MACHINE *** The path was rewritten from the official page in an OFFLINE slice (no COM run) - see scripts/sw_sheet_metal.py::SHEET_METAL_RUNTIME_STATUS (still `None` = untested).
docs.solidworks_sheet_metal_create_swept_flan: Create a native swept flange along a path. REQUIRES an existing base flange first (the official example builds one before the swept flange) - otherwise there is no thickness to inherit. NOT YET TESTED ON A REAL MACHINE: it needs both a sweep path and a profile selection, which the 2026-10-01 probe did not build. See scripts/sw_sheet_metal.py::SHEET_METAL_RUNTIME_STATUS before relying on it.
docs.solidworks_current_selection: Read the current selection set (optionally filtered to one selection mark).
docs.solidworks_set_standard_view: Switch the model to a named standard view (e.g. isometric, front, top).
docs.solidworks_list_render_materials: List the render materials available in the active document.
docs.solidworks_collect_appearance_evidence: Collect appearance evidence for the active document (read-only, for verification). ★ 别名: appearance, background, scene
docs.solidworks_available_point_selectors: List the point-selector names usable when specifying geometry (no document needed).
docs.solidworks_available_direction_selectors: List the direction-selector names usable when specifying geometry (no document needed).
docs.solidworks_collect_assembly_bom: Read the assembly BOM as structured rows (the CSV-export tool is a different one).
docs.solidworks_activate_model_for_preview: Activate the model for preview/review (prepares the document for capture). ⚠ May mark the document as modified (view/selection state changes count).
docs.solidworks_clear_selection_for_preview: Clear the selection so the preview does not show highlighted entities. ⚠ May mark the document as modified (view/selection state changes count).
docs.solidworks_refresh_scene_graph: Refresh the graphics/scene graph, e.g. after an appearance change. ⚠ May mark the document as modified (view/selection state changes count).
docs.solidworks_collect_model_summary: Summarise the model: title, type, feature tree (name + type), save path.
docs.solidworks_get_costing_manager: Get the SOLIDWORKS Costing manager object for the active document.
docs.solidworks_list_simulation_study_options: List the simulation study option setters available (no document needed).
docs.solidworks_mold_core_cavity_split: Split the mold into core and cavity solids (this is the tooling split). ⚠ 0.0 means 'use the document default' for scale/thickness/offset.
docs.solidworks_mold_undercut_detect: Detect mold undercuts along a direction. ⚠ The underlying IFeatureManager.MoldUndercutDetect is marked Obsolete by SOLIDWORKS (successor: MoldUndercutDetect2); kept deliberately until the successor shape is verified. See docs/obsolete-member-candidates.md. ★★ Parameter names now follow the official md (ColUndercut/ColBase/BCoordInput/Dx/Dy/Dz); the earlier names (direction/option/include_hidden/a/b/c) did not, so the third argument BCoordInput received False — which drops back to 'use the model's own draft direction' and pops the modal 「此拔模方向尚未定义。」 on a part without one, stalling the session.
docs.solidworks_part_bounding_box: Get the bounding box of the first solid body. ⚠⚠ SOLIDWORKS documents the returned values as APPROXIMATE and says they 'should not be used for comparison or calculation purposes'; the box may also vary after a rebuild. Use this for a rough overview only. ⚠ Units are MILLIMETRES (measured on SW 2026 SP4.1: an 80x60x50 mm box returns 80/60/50, not 0.08/0.06/0.05).
docs.solidworks_hole_standards: List the Hole Wizard standards available for a hole type (official ISldWorks.GetHoleStandardsData + IHoleStandardsData.GetHoleStandards). Returns [{id, name}, ...]; the two out parameters are paired positionally. ⚠ Officially returns null when hole_type_id is 5 (swWzdLegacy).
docs.solidworks_fastener_types: List the fastener types under a Hole Wizard standard. Returns [{id, name}, ...]. ⚠ The names follow the SOLIDWORKS UI language (a Chinese UI returns Chinese names); do not assume English. Use an id from this list as fastener_id elsewhere. ⚠ Internally the IHoleStandardsData object must be primed with GetHoleStandards first, otherwise SOLIDWORKS returns False (measured); this function does that.
docs.solidworks_fastener_table_types: List the fastener table type ids for one fastener (official IHoleStandardsData.GetFastenerTableTypes). ⚠ The official second parameter is an Int32 FASTENER ID (from solidworks_fastener_types), not a size name - passing a size name raises a type-mismatch error. Returns a list of ints.
docs.solidworks_topology_create_mass_constrai: Create a mass constraint for a topology study (mass-reduction percent semantics). Returns the constraint object.
docs.solidworks_topology_create_factor_of_saf: Create a factor-of-safety constraint for a topology study (stress must stay below that percentage of yield strength).
docs.solidworks_topology_create_preserved_reg: Create a preserved region for a topology study (material that must not be removed). ⚠ `option` is an official enum value; omit to use the default.
docs.solidworks_topology_create_thickness_con: Create a thickness control for a topology study (minimum/maximum thickness). Units are millimetres (rule 2).
docs.solidworks_topology_create_demold_contro: Create a de-mold (manufacturing) control for a topology study. The caller must first select the pull-direction face/edge/plane, then choose the direction option.
docs.solidworks_topology_create_stress_constr: Create a stress constraint for a topology study.
docs.solidworks_topology_create_symmetry_cont: Create a symmetry control for a topology study. The caller must first select the symmetry plane(s).
docs.solidworks_simulation_generate_report: Generate a study report to a file. ⚠ `template` valid values were NOT found in the local sources (see the batch header); pass the template name your SolidWorks installation provides.
docs.solidworks_simulation_create_mesh_for_co: Mesh the study using a named mesh control.
docs.solidworks_simulation_default_element_si: Get the suggested element size and tolerance (millimetre-scale when units=-1).
docs.solidworks_get_active_view: Get the currently active 3D view (the official member is IModelDoc.ActiveView).
docs.solidworks_entities_on_body: List the entities of one body **with geometry** (kind EDGE, FACE, or VERTEX). ★ 每条带可 JSON 化的读数：EDGE ⇒ 两个端点 + **自己算的**边长（★ 官方 `IEdge` **没有**长度成员）· FACE ⇒ `IFace2.GetArea()` · VERTEX ⇒ `IVertex.GetPoint()`。★★ 同时回 **欧拉校验 `V−E+F=2`**（★ 本仓既有判据，不需新 API）✓ ⚠ Index order is NOT promised stable by the official API — do not treat body_index as a persistent reference across rebuilds. ★ 别名: body, edge, edges, entit, vertex, vertices
docs.solidworks_build_review_report: Build structured review-report data (exports preview images and writes a report into output_dir). ⚠ The optional `views` / `expected_outputs` list parameters are NOT exposed in this tool — see the batch header for why.
docs.solidworks_add_sketch_relation: Add a sketch geometric relation to the current selection.
docs.solidworks_mirror_feature: Mirror an existing feature about a plane.
docs.solidworks_circular_pattern: Create a circular pattern about an axis.
docs.solidworks_revolve_boss: Revolve a profile sketch into a boss feature. ⚠ This call is routed through a closed-source COM backend — see docs/known-facts.md.
docs.solidworks_sketch_count_lines: Count the straight LINES in a sketch. ⚠ Use this rather than the raw getter: the underlying ISketch call returns a NUMBER array (12 floats per line), which cannot answer "how many lines".
docs.solidworks_sketch_count_arcs: Count the ARCS in a sketch (the underlying call returns 16 floats per arc). ⚠ A full CIRCLE counts as ONE arc — verified on a real machine (2026-10-01): a sketch with 1 line + 1 circle reports count_lines=1, count_arcs=1, count_segments=2.
docs.solidworks_sketch_count_segments: Count ALL segments in a sketch. ⚠ Not the same as the line count: segments are the total geometry units; lines are one kind among them.
docs.solidworks_sketch_is_3d: Whether the sketch is a 3D sketch (ISketch.Is3D).
docs.solidworks_drawing_list_sheets: Sheet overview of the active drawing: how many sheets, their names, and which one is current. ★ Works on the CURRENTLY ACTIVE document only — no path needed. This is the difference from solidworks_inspect_drawing, which takes a drawing_path, opens the file itself and writes previews + a report. Raises if the active document is not a drawing (GetType() != 3).
docs.solidworks_drawing_get_current_sheet: Read the current sheet: paper size (name + code), WIDTH/HEIGHT IN MILLIMETRES, scale, projection angle and sheet-format name. ⚠ The API returns width/height in METRES; this tool converts once, at the boundary, and reports millimetres. ★ Works on the CURRENTLY ACTIVE document only — no path needed. This is the difference from solidworks_inspect_drawing, which takes a drawing_path, opens the file itself and writes previews + a report. Raises if the active document is not a drawing (GetType() != 3).
docs.solidworks_drawing_list_views: List the views on the CURRENT SHEET: name + type code. ⚠ The sheet itself is NOT reported as a view — the raw API returns it as a pseudo-view (Type == 1) and that is filtered out here. ★ Works on the CURRENTLY ACTIVE document only — no path needed. This is the difference from solidworks_inspect_drawing, which takes a drawing_path, opens the file itself and writes previews + a report. Raises if the active document is not a drawing (GetType() != 3).
docs.solidworks_custom_property_get: Read ONE file custom property: its value, its type (swCustomInfoType_e) and whether it is editable. ★ Reading only — writing is solidworks_set_custom_properties. The API's by-ref getters (Get2..Get6) do NOT work under pywin32 (they raise a type-mismatch error), so these tools use the single-return Get(name); that shape is verified on a real machine.
docs.solidworks_custom_property_list: Read ALL file custom properties of the active document: every name with its value and type, plus how many were read. ★ Reading only — writing is solidworks_set_custom_properties. The API's by-ref getters (Get2..Get6) do NOT work under pywin32 (they raise a type-mismatch error), so these tools use the single-return Get(name); that shape is verified on a real machine.
docs.solidworks_sketch_start: Enter a new sketch on a reference plane. ★ This is the prerequisite for every sketch-based feature (extrude, revolve, hole, sheet-metal flange).
docs.solidworks_sketch_end: Leave the current sketch. ★ The resulting sketch reference is reusable by solidworks_extrude_* and other feature tools, so features can be built right after.
docs.solidworks_sketch_add_line: Draw a straight LINE in the open sketch. ⚠ Sketch geometry MUST be given as in-plane coordinates — this is the documented exception in rule 3 (a *drawing primitive* has no named entity to select). Coordinates are millimetres, relative to the SKETCH ORIGIN, in the sketch plane. ★ Start a sketch with solidworks_sketch_start first, and finish with solidworks_sketch_end; read back with the solidworks_sketch_count_* tools.
docs.solidworks_sketch_add_circle: Draw a CIRCLE in the open sketch. ⚠ Sketch geometry MUST be given as in-plane coordinates — this is the documented exception in rule 3 (a *drawing primitive* has no named entity to select). Coordinates are millimetres, relative to the SKETCH ORIGIN, in the sketch plane. ★ Start a sketch with solidworks_sketch_start first, and finish with solidworks_sketch_end; read back with the solidworks_sketch_count_* tools.
docs.solidworks_sketch_add_rectangle: Draw a RECTANGLE in the open sketch, given TWO OPPOSITE CORNERS. ⚠ Not the same as a centre+size rectangle — this tool takes corners, which is unambiguous. ⚠ Sketch geometry MUST be given as in-plane coordinates — this is the documented exception in rule 3 (a *drawing primitive* has no named entity to select). Coordinates are millimetres, relative to the SKETCH ORIGIN, in the sketch plane. ★ Start a sketch with solidworks_sketch_start first, and finish with solidworks_sketch_end; read back with the solidworks_sketch_count_* tools.
docs.solidworks_extrude_boss: Extrude a sketch into a solid BOSS (adds material). ★ This is the first tool in the repo that turns a sketch into a solid body. ★ depth_mm is in MILLIMETRES and is converted to metres at this boundary.
docs.solidworks_extrude_cut: Extrude a sketch as a CUT (removes material). ★ depth_mm = 0 means through-all. ⚠ The correct entry point for a cut is FeatureCut4, not FeatureExtrusion3 with flip=True — the capability layer already handles that.
docs.solidworks_extrude_midplane: Extrude a sketch symmetrically about its plane. ⚠ The parameter is the TOTAL depth, not the per-side depth. ★ The value is in MILLIMETRES and is converted to the metres that IFeatureManager.FeatureExtrusion3 expects — the conversion happens here, once.
docs.solidworks_chamfer: Chamfer the selected edge(s). ★ The edge comes from `selection` (declarative), because the API takes no edge object — it acts on the current selection.
docs.solidworks_fillet: Round the selected edge(s) with the given radius. ★ The edge comes from `selection` (declarative) — the capability layer passes edges=None, i.e. it acts on the current selection.
docs.solidworks_feature_suppress: Suppress one FEATURE via the successor entry point `IModelDoc2.EditSuppress2()` (0 params). ★ It acts on the CURRENT SELECTION, so the capability layer selects the named feature first and REFUSES to call when the selection read-back is 0 (an empty selection would silently do nothing).
docs.solidworks_feature_unsuppress: Unsuppress one FEATURE via the successor entry point `IModelDoc2.EditUnsuppress2()` (0 params). ★ Same selection contract and same refusal guard as `solidworks_feature_suppress`.
docs.solidworks_feature_delete: Delete one FEATURE via `IModelDoc2.EditDelete()` (0 params, NOT deprecated). ★ It acts on the CURRENT SELECTION, so the capability layer selects the named feature first and REFUSES to call when the selection read-back is 0. ★ The official return is `void`, so success is observed as the feature disappearing from the tree.
docs.solidworks_part_mass_properties: Read the mass properties of the ACTIVE part, without any conversion: volume (mm^3), surface area (mm^2), centre of mass (mm, three components) and density. ★★ IMPORTANT: the API is measured to return MILLIMETRE-based values (a 40x20x10 mm box reports volume 8000 and surface area 2800), NOT SI metres — so nothing here is scaled. ⚠★ `mass` is passed through as reported, but ITS PHYSICAL UNIT IS NOT VERIFIED: on the test box its value equals volume(mm^3) x density, which does not form a consistent unit with either mm^3 or m^3 — treat the number as unverified rather than assume a unit. ⚠ `AccuracyLevel` is not exposed (the member is not readable on this build). ★ Reading only; writing overrides is a different capability.
docs.solidworks_assembly_list_components: List the components of the ACTIVE assembly: for each one its name, file path, whether it is suppressed and whether it is visible. ★ Reading only. ★ 别名: batch, list, operation, operations
docs.solidworks_assembly_list_mates: List the MateGroup and mate features of the active assembly (name, type, tree depth). ★ Use it to check that real mates were actually written into the feature tree — it does NOT report degrees of freedom.
docs.solidworks_assembly_check_interference: Run interference detection on the ACTIVE assembly and return an auditable report: `status` (pass when nothing interferes / warn when something does / blocked when the check itself failed), `interference_count`, and per-interference `volume` + `component_count`. ⚠ `blocked` means the CHECK failed — do not read it as 'no interference'. ★ Reading only (it runs the detector, it does not change the model).
docs.solidworks_simulation_apply_fixed_restra: Apply a FIXED restraint (fixture) to the selected face(s) of a static study and return the ICWRestraint. ★ The faces come from `selection` (declarative) because the capability layer assembles them into the official DispArray. ⚠ Requires the Simulation add-in; the first call loads it automatically.
docs.solidworks_simulation_apply_normal_force: Apply a NORMAL force to the selected face(s) of a static study and return the ICWForce. ★ The faces come from `selection` (declarative). ⚠ The magnitude is in NEWTONS — it is not converted.

docs.solidworks_surface_fill: ★ **填充曲面** —— 走 `IFeatureManager.InsertFillSurface2`（官方 **6 参**）。★★ 判据（规则 6）：**回 `Feature` 非 None** **且** **特征树增量非空**。★ 真机证据：建 `曲面填充1`（树 7→8）· 负例 `resolutions = 9` ⇒ 显式拒绝。★★ **边界边按中点 + `mark = 1` 选**（★ 官方 Remarks；`Select4` 没有 mark 参数 —— 事实 32；传 mark = 4 会静默失败：回 true 而计数 0 —— 事实 8）。★★ 2026-10-03（轮 435）**两条路都已真机 PASS**：★ 各建成 `曲面填充1`（树 [7,8]）。★ 而**选边时请用 `mark = 1`**（官方 Remarks：边界边用 mark 1）。★ 留空 `selection` 时**自动取最高那一圈**（★ 保留原行为）。
docs.solidworks_measure_selection: ★ **量声明式选区里的实体**（逐几何量测）—— 走 `IModelDocExtension.CreateMeasure` → `IMeasure`。★★ **用 `selection` + `selection_kind` 说明量什么**（★ 规则 3：**不收坐标**；★ 函数在**注入之后**自己重建选区 —— ★ 事实 503：注入解析器会清空选区）。★ 调用序照官方示例：`Extension` → `CreateMeasure` → 设 `ArcOption` → `Calculate` → 读数。★ 回的 `values` 含 `distance` / `normal_distance` / `angle` / `length` / `area` / `perimeter` / `delta_x` / `delta_y` / `delta_z` 等；判定含 `is_intersect` / `is_parallel` / `is_perpendicular`。★★ 约定：**-1 表示「这项对当前选择不适用」** —— 本工具如实保留 -1，并另给 `applicable` 列出真量到的项。★ 真机期望（几何推出，全部对上）：两面 ⇒ `distance` 10.0mm · 单面 ⇒ `area` 400mm² · `perimeter` 80mm。★ 未选中 ⇒ 显式拒绝。⚠ 量测要先选中（规则 3：本工具不传坐标，选中由声明式选择那族负责）。
docs.solidworks_part_loft: ★ **用「轮廓草图」放样** —— 走 `IFeatureManager.InsertProtrusionBlend2`（官方 **18 参**）。★ 官方 Remarks：轮廓要**按期望的顺序**先选中，mark=**1**（引导线 mark=2 · 中心线 mark=4 · 起端相切向量 mark=8）；★ 引导线与中心线**可选**。★★ **`profile_sketches` 是必填的**：★ 本工具**不预选任何东西**，而是由 `pre_call` 在**注入之后**按名把每个轮廓选上（**mark=1**）并**回读计数**（★ 事实 8）—— ★ 名字**按顺序**给（顺序即语义）。⚠ 早先版本**没有**这个参数、也没有 `pre_call` ⇒ **经工具层必然失败**（真机报 `stage: selection`，证据 `output/explicit-reject-family-evidence.json`）。★★ 判据（规则 6）：**特征树多了新特征**。★ 真机证据：同平面与两平面两种情形都建成 `放样1`。⚠ **未真机验证**：质量属性里的**体积**（★ 真机上回 0.0，所以「棱台体积 7000 mm³」那个期望值没有对上）—— ★ 不要把本工具的体积当可靠读数。
docs.solidworks_part_sweep: ★ **用「轮廓 + 路径」建扫描特征** —— 走官方**现代入口** `IFeatureManager.CreateDefinition(swFmSweep=17)` → `ISweepFeatureData` → `CreateFeature`（★ `InsertProtrusionSwept*` 整族已被 SOLIDWORKS 2018 标为 **obsolete**）。★ 官方专文给的 mark：**轮廓 = 1** · **路径 = 4** · 引导线 = 2 · 方向向量 = 128。★★ **`profile_sketch` 与 `path_sketch` 是必填的**：★ 本工具**不预选任何东西**，而是由 `pre_call` 在**注入之后**按上表把这两个草图选上并**回读计数**（★ 事实 8）。⚠ 早先版本**没有**这两个参数、也没有 `pre_call` ⇒ **经工具层必然失败**（真机报 `stage: selection`，证据 `output/explicit-reject-family-evidence.json`）。⚠ 官方硬约束：**路径的起点必须落在轮廓所在平面上**（1 方向扫描）—— 真机上违反它就会建不成。★★ 判据（事实 242：挑只依赖被测对象的那个）：**特征树多了新特征** **且** **类型名 = `Sweep`**。★ 真机证据：建成 `扫描1`（type=`Sweep`）。⚠ `AccessSelections` 在本机报 `0x80010105`（事实 47 的后端限制）——★ 而**它非必需**：真机上它报错时特征仍建成，所以本工具**不拿它当判据**。
docs.solidworks_part_axis: ★ **从声明式选区建一条参考轴** —— 走 `IModelDoc2.InsertAxis2`（★ **注意入口在 `IModelDoc2` 上**，不在 `IFeatureManager` 上；★ 真机调后者报`AttributeError: <unknown>.InsertAxis2`）。★★ 用 `selection` + `selection_kind` 说明用哪个几何（★ 规则 3：**不收坐标**；★ 函数会在**注入之后**自己重建选区 —— ★ 事实 503：注入解析器会清空选区）。★★ 判据（★ 事实 242 挑只依赖被测对象的那个）：**它回 `True`** **且** **特征树出现新特征**（★ 真机：`基准轴1`）—— ⚠ **不要读返回值的 `.Name`**：真机证明它回的是 **`bool`**，读 `.Name` 会报 `'bool' object has no attribute 'Name'`（★ 差点据此误判「轴没建成」）。★ 环形阵列的前置：官方 `FeatureCircularPattern4` 的 mark 表要求 `1 = 方向轴`。
docs.solidworks_part_wrap: ★ **对已选中的「草图（mark=4）+ 面（mark=1）」建包覆特征** —— 走官方 `IFeatureManager.InsertWrapFeature2`（**5 参**）。★ 官方要求：★ **草图 mark = 4**（★ 且**必须是 2D 草图**，官方原话 「3D sketches are invalid」）· ★ **面 mark = 1** · ★ 拔模方向 mark = 2（仅 Emboss/Engrave 用）。★★ 判据 = **读返回对象的 `Name` 与 `GetTypeName2`** —— ★ 真机：返回 `包覆1` · 类型名 **`Emboss`**；⚠ 而 `feature_names()` 的**前后 diff 是空的**（★ 所以「树 diff」不是可靠判据）。⚠ **未验**：`Type` 传非 emboss 时**类型名不变**（★ 参数被静默忽略）· `Method` / `MeshFactor`（第 4/5 参）**取值表没查到**（用 0）。
docs.solidworks_read_sensors: ★ **列出文档里的传感器并读它们当前的值** —— 走 `ISensor`（10 个成员）。★ 官方入口现状：★ **能读不能建**（反射里没有 `AddXxxSensor`）· ★ **也没有「列出所有传感器」的成员** ⇒ ★ 本工具走**特征树遍历 + `GetSpecificFeature2()`**。★ `GetSensorValue(out double Value, out string Units)` 的官方签名是 **0 参 + 2 个 out**（★ 反射里 `'GetSensorValue': 0` 那行才是 arity）。★ 判据：**函数跑到尾且结构完整** —— ★ 空文档回 `count=0` 且不炸是对的。★ 真机证据（PASS 3/3）：空零件 / 有几何的零件 / 带外部参考的示例图，三处 `ok=True` · `count=0` · `errors=[]`。⚠ **未真机验证**：**非空路径**（★ 那三个文档都没有传感器，而官方**不能建** —— 要造非空场景只能手工在 UI 里建）· 以及 `Units` 那个 out 参数的实际取值。
docs.solidworks_read_document_units: ★ **读文档单位**（★ 两条路：主源 + 对照源，★ 它们是**不同层次**、**允许不同**）。★ 主源 `IModelDoc2.GetUnits()`（**0 参**）—— 官方 Remarks 原话：返回 **5 个 short 的数组** `[LengthUnit, FractionBase, FractionValue, SignificantDigits, RoundToFraction]`，`LengthUnit` 取 `swLengthUnit_e`（`swMM = 0`）。★ 对照源 `ISldWorks.GetUserPreferenceIntegerValue(swUnitsLinear = 47)` —— ★ **1 参**（★ 三源一致：官方签名 / 反射 / 官方示例），★ 它是**系统默认**（★ 新建文档的默认），**不是**文档级。★★ 判据：**`LengthUnit` 应为 0（`swMM`）** —— ★ 因为本仓库**建模一律按毫米**；★ 不是 0 就说明该文档单位不是毫米，★ 而那时「我们的 mm 参数」与文档单位之间存在**未声明的换算**。★ 真机证据（PASS 4/4）：`GetUnits()` ⇒ `(0, 1, 8, 2, 0)` ⇒ `LengthUnit = 0` = `swMM` · `is_mm = true`；系统默认也 = 0；`doc_matches_system_default = true`。⚠ **未真机验证**：`SetUnits`（★ 5 参，★ 本工具只读不写）· 非毫米文档下的读数（★ 本机文档都是毫米）。
docs.solidworks_undo: ★ **撤销** —— 走 `IModelDoc2.EditUndo2`（官方 **1 参** · ★★ **返回 `void`**）。★★ 判据（规则 6）：**特征树真的退回了**（真机：7 → 6 · 撤掉 `凸台-拉伸1`）。★ 负例 `steps = 0` ⇒ 显式拒绝。⚠ **调用纪律**：★ 它撤的是**会话里的动作**、**不区分是不是我们做的** ⇒ ★ **只在我们自己的改动之后调用**（★ 例如「建完发现参数错 ⇒ 撕掉重来」）。
docs.solidworks_selection_count: ★ **回读当前选区计数**（`ISelectionMgr.GetSelectedObjectCount2(-1)`）。★★ 它是**选择类判据的唯一来源** —— 事实 8：`SelectByID2` / `Select4` 的 bool 返回值不可信（实测 12 次全 false 而计数 = 12）⇒ ★ **判「选没选中」永远看本工具的回读数**。
docs.solidworks_select_entity_by_index: ★ **按序号选中体上的一个实体**（`kind` = `EDGE` / `FACE` / `VERTEX`，`index` 从 0 起）。★ 走 `IEntity.Select4`（★ 事实 32：对边/面**按名字选不中**，按**对象**选才行）。★ 返回**回读到的选区计数**。⚠ 序号顺序官方**未承诺稳定**（★ 见 `entities_on_body`）⇒ 不要把它当跨重建的持久引用。
docs.solidworks_resolve_selection: ★ **把声明式选择器解析并选中**，只回报**回读到的选区计数**。★ 选择器：`__current_selection__`（用当前选区第一个，**不重选**）· `index:<n>`（体上第 n 个）。★ 计数为 0 时**抛错**（★ 本项目一贯纪律：选不中就报错，不静默继续）。
docs.solidworks_selection_point: ★ **读当前选区那个点的坐标**（★ **毫米**，规则 2）。★★ 用途：★ 孔族吃 `center`（一个坐标元组）⇒ 包一层「**先选点、再建孔**」⇒ ★ **工具层的参数里就没有坐标了**（★ 规则 3 的精神）。★ 回 `{ok, point_mm, selection_count, error}`；⚠ **不猜**：★ `GetSelectionPoint` 取不到就 `ok=False` 并写明原因（★ 铁律 5）。
docs.solidworks_select_by_selector: ★ **用声明式选择器选中一个实体** —— ★ MCP 可用的形态（★ 只回 JSON，**不回 COM 对象**）。★ 它把 `select_object`（吃 COM 对象）与 `resolve_entity`（吐 COM 对象）**接起来**。★★ 判据是 `count`（★ 事实 8：`Select4` 的返回值不可信，只有回读算数）；★ 计数为 0 时 `ok=False` **并写明原因**。
docs.solidworks_resolve_entity: ★ **解析声明式选择器并回报结果**（★ 只回 JSON —— 把 COM 对象挡在里面）。★ `resolve_entity` 本身**返回 COM 对象** ⇒ MCP 层过不去 ⇒ 本工具换成可核对的描述。★ 回 `{ok, selector, kind, count, resolved}`：★ `resolved` = 解析出了对象；★★ 而**是否真的在选区里**看 `count`（★ **解析出来 ≠ 选中**）；★ 而 `__current_selection__` 是**不重选**的 ⇒ 那种情况下 `resolved=True` 而 `count=0` 是正常的。

docs.solidworks_simulation_create_mesh_safely: **THE RECOMMENDED WAY to mesh a study.** One call does seven things, all measured: ① element-size sanity gate (two-sided: too big = degenerate, too small = memory blow-up) → ② **mesh safety profile** (`Quality=Draft` + `MesherType=Standard`, i.e. turns OFF the curvature-based mesher that refines without a lower bound) → ③ build the mesh → ④ read the REAL `ElementCount`/`NodeCount` → ⑤ **pre-solve memory gate** → ⑥ **restore the study's mesh settings** → ⑦ return an evidence-ready report. ★★ Measured on a real machine (100x60x20 mm plate): the factory settings gave 11301 nodes, the safety profile gave **1492 nodes (7.6x fewer)** and meshed in 0.3-0.8 s. ⚠ The estimate uses the official **FFEPlus** rule (1 GB per 2,000,000 DOF); if the study solves with a direct solver that rule does not apply — check `solidworks_simulation_solver_type`. ★★ Read `blocked` when `ok` is false: it says WHICH gate refused (`MESH_SIZE_UNSANE` / `MESH_SAFETY_APPLY_FAILED` / `MESH_FAILED` / `SOLVE_MEMORY_BUDGET`).
docs.solidworks_simulation_solver_type: Return `{ok, value, name, reason}` for `ICWStaticStudyOptions.SolverType` (`swsSolverType_e`: automatic 0 / direct_sparse 1 / ffeplus 2 / casi 5 / abaqus 6 / intel 7 / intel_cluster 8). ★★ **Why it matters**: the repo's solve-memory estimate uses the official **FFEPlus** rule ("1 GB per 2,000,000 degrees of freedom"), and that rule is FFEPlus-specific. Measured here: `SolverType` read back as `automatic (0)` while the solver actually chosen at solve time was **Intel Direct Sparse** — a direct solver, for which this repo has NO official memory rule. ⚠ When the read fails, `ok` is false with a reason — it never guesses a default.

docs.solidworks_repo_find_real_implementation: Search the repo for real implementations and return `["file:line", …]`. ★★ **Why this exists**: the repo's `sw_api_*.py` files are machine-generated reflection dumps that mention every member name — a naive grep matches those and tells you nothing. docs.solidworks_session_stuck_status: Report whether SolidWorks looks stuck, using BOTH signals: it is not responding **and** no solver process is alive. ★★ That second half matters — during a long solve the main window can look 'not responding' while `star.exe` is happily working, and calling that 'stuck' is how a normal solve gets killed (facts 293/526).
docs.solidworks_session_solver_processes: List the solver kernels currently running (the COSMOS/M family, enumerated via the Toolhelp32 snapshot — no `tasklist` parsing). ★ Use it to tell 'still solving' from 'crashed', and to confirm a solver actually exited.
docs.solidworks_session_wait_until_idle: Block until `solidworks_session_busy_status` reports idle, or until the timeout — ★ it always returns, and says whether it actually reached idle. ★★ Use it before driving COM: landing a call while SolidWorks is busy is the documented route to a hung session (fact 526). ⚠ It polls; it does not touch the model.
